subject: ArchTech readiness plan & questionnaire launch
messages:
From: Olivia Trent <olivia.trent@archtech.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Markus Vogel <markus@archtech.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's demo

Hi Karthish,

Thanks for the demo this morning — it was helpful to see the latency/cost controls in action. Markus and I sketched a rough plan during the call and want to kick off the security review ASAP so procurement can start their intake.

Can you send over: 
- The vendor questionnaire you'd like us to fill out
- A short list of what systems we should include in scope (we currently expect: API gateway, customer-facing webapp, data lake, and SSO)
- Any standard network diagram you prefer we use as a template

Also, who should procurement loop in from Redwood (name + email) so we can send the official RFx?

Thanks,
Olivia
Director of Platform Engineering
ArchTech

From: Karthish Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Trent <olivia.trent@archtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ArchTech readiness plan & questionnaire launch

Hi Olivia — great to meet you and Markus today.

Short answers up front and next steps:

1) Questionnaire: Attached is our standard security questionnaire (redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf). Please fill sections A–D; we can pre-populate any service-level answers if helpful.

2) Systems in scope: Your list sounds right. For clarity, please confirm these map to:
   - API gateway (public ingress)
   - Customer-facing webapp (hosted on AWS us-west-2)
   - Data lake (S3 + analytics cluster)
   - SSO (Okta tenant)

3) Network diagram: If you can share your internal diagram we will annotate which endpoints we touch. If you prefer, we can provide a blank template.

4) Procurement contact: loop procurement@archtech.com; our procurement lead for this deal is Rafael Mendes (rafael.mendes@redwood.com) — he'll own contract/terms.

Next steps proposed:
- I’ll attach the questionnaire now (attached).
- Can you return the completed questionnaire and your network diagram by Friday 11/5?
- Neha will join a technical kickoff to walk systems in scope once we receive the questionnaire — proposed window: week of 11/8.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Olivia Trent <olivia.trent@archtech.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Markus Vogel <markus@archtech.com>, procurement@archtech.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ArchTech readiness plan & questionnaire launch

Karthik,

Thanks — got the questionnaire. Markus and I discussed and procurement wants an initial scope confirmation before they accept the RFx. I've attached our current network diagram (archtech-network-diagram.png).

A couple clarifications from our side:
- Data residency: our analytics cluster stores PII in a separate bucket; procurement flagged that as an item for the review.
- Encryption: we currently use SSE-KMS for S3; we'd like to confirm how Redwood handles customer-managed keys in the Private deployment option.

Procurement contact for contract intake is procurement@archtech.com (cc'd). Can you confirm Rafael will handle redlines and whom we should expect for SOC2 evidence/attestation?

Thanks,
Olivia

Hi Olivia / procurement team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the diagram.

A couple of concrete items to keep the timeline moving:
- Rafael will be the point for contract and redlines — Rafael, I’ve looped you so you can confirm standard terms vs any exceptions.
- For SOC2 evidence: Marissa will share our SOC2 report and the minimal attestation set procurement typically requests. Marissa — can you also surface any network-level artifacts we can share (list of ingress/egress ranges, sample audit log retention policy)?
- Neha will schedule a 45-minute technical kickoff (tentatively 11/9 10:00 PT) to walk the Okta integration and how our Private deployment supports CMK.

To procurement: we uploaded a deal workspace here for shared artifacts and questionnaire status: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4729.

Requested deliverables and owners:
- Completed questionnaire (Olivia / ArchTech) — due 2026-11-05
- Annotated network diagram (ArchTech or we can annotate) — due 2026-11-05
- SOC2 and supporting artifacts (Marissa) — asap once procurement confirms required items

If that timeline works, I’ll have Neha send a calendar invite for the technical kickoff and Rafael will follow up on contract timeline.

Thanks all — look forward to getting this underway.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
